description: Get the CURRENT FULL TEXT of a section of the Washington Administrative Code (WAC) — Washington state agency RULES / regulations — by citation. "WAC 296-800-110" is L&I's safe-workplace summary; "458-20-178" is the Department of Revenue use-tax rule. Returns the rule text, its caption, the statutory-authority history (every WSR filing that amended it, with filed/effective dates) and the RCW sections the agency cited as authority. A repealed or nonexistent section is reported as found:false (the site redirects it). Keyless. Use for "what does WAC 296-800-110 say", "text of WAC 388-76-10000", or to check a Washington regulation an agency decision cites. For STATUTES (RCW) use wa_rcw_section; for past years use wa_wac_archived_section; to search by topic use wa_wac_search.

section.description: WAC citation, title-chapter-section, e.g. "296-800-110" or "WAC 458-20-178". Chapter and title parts may carry a letter suffix ("296-14A-100", "132C-120-010").
